units.title: Pharmacy price estimates basis
units.text: Prices on this page are estimates for a 30-day supply at a preferred retail pharmacy, based on the plan information we have today.
units.source_span: Prices on this page are estimates for a 30-day supply at a preferred retail pharmacy, based on the plan information we have today.

units.title: Factors that change the amount you pay
units.text: The amount you pay may differ if the pharmacy, the days' supply, or your stage of coverage is different.
units.source_span: The amount you pay may differ if the pharmacy, the days' supply, or your stage of coverage is different.

units.title: Estimate is not a guarantee of payment
units.text: An estimate is not a guarantee of payment.
units.source_span: An estimate is not a guarantee of payment.

units.title: Why the pharmacy charged a different amount
units.text: Q: Why did the pharmacy charge a different amount? A: The pharmacy may have used a different days' supply, or your coverage stage may have changed since you looked at this page.
units.source_span: The pharmacy may have used a different days' supply, or your coverage stage may have changed since you looked at this page.

units.title: Getting the current price estimate
units.text: Call the number on your member ID card and an advocate can read the current estimate.
units.source_span: Call the number on your member ID card and an advocate can read the current estimate.

units.title: Who to call about drug prices
units.text: Q: Who do I call? A: Call Harbor Health Member Services at the number on your ID card and ask for the pharmacy education team.
units.source_span: Call Harbor Health Member Services at the number on your ID card and ask for the pharmacy education team.
